name: T12-WF12 - AI Quote and Proposal Agent

parameters.content:
## 1. Sales Request
NestJS authenticates Sales, checks Customer/Lead scope and creates WorkflowRun.

## 2. Customer & Catalog
Use known catalog item IDs and explicitly labelled demo/live provenance.

## 3. AI Drafting & Validation
AI writes proposal language only. It cannot set authoritative prices.

## 4. Backend Pricing & Approval
NestJS calculates money, persists draft and owns Quote approval state.

nodes.name: Code: Validate Requirements
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential required. Browser must call NestJS, never this webhook directly.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { customerId: $node['Code: Validate Requirements'].json.customerId || null, leadId: $node['Code: Validate Requirements'].json.leadId || null, workflowRunId: $node['Code: Validate Requirements'].json.workflowRunId, n8nExecutionId: String($exec.id) } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Get Customer Context
nodes.notes: Canonical customer route; backend service identity must enforce the caller/resource scope. Lead-to-customer context may need an equivalent internal route.

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Get Product and Pricing Catalog

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $node["Code: Normalize Requirements"].json.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Gemini Proposal Draft
nodes.notes: GEMINI_API_KEY is read from n8n environment. Do not embed credentials in workflow JSON.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { workflowRunId: $node['Code: Validate Requirements'].json.workflowRunId, customerId: $node['Code: Validate Requirements'].json.customerId, leadId: $node['Code: Validate Requirements'].json.leadId, items: $node['Code: Parse Line Items'].json.proposalDraft.lineItems, currency: $node['Code: Parse Line Items'].json.currency, n8nExecutionId: String($exec.id), idempotencyKey: $node['Code: Validate Requirements'].json.workflowRunId } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Backend Pricing Validation
nodes.notes: BACKEND API: price-preview is implemented by the T12 workflow backend patch. Must calculate totals/taxes/discounts in NestJS only.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { workflowRunId: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.workflowRunId, customerId: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.customerId, leadId: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.leadId, title: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.proposalDraft.title, executiveSummary: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.proposalDraft.executiveSummary, body: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.proposalDraft.body, items: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.proposalDraft.lineItems, n8nExecutionId: String($exec.id), currency: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.currency } }}

parameters.url: ={{ ($env.BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL || 'http://localhost:3000') + '/api/v1/internal/n8n/quotes/' + ($node['HTTP Request: Save Draft'].json.id || $node['HTTP Request: Save Draft'].json.data?.id) + '/submit-for-approval' }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { workflowRunId: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.workflowRunId, n8nExecutionId: String($exec.id), idempotencyKey: $node['Code: Determine Approval Requirement'].json.workflowRunId } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Create Approval Task
nodes.notes: Canonical quote submit-for-approval endpoint. NestJS creates/reuses the approval task and controls state transitions.

main.node: HTTP Request: Get Product and Pricing Catalog

description: Owner: Tuấn Anh. Protected internal webhook. NestJS catalog/pricing/quote service is authoritative. Backend price-preview route is provisional and must be implemented before activation. Atomic WorkflowRun claim is folded into the customer-context request; the graph has exactly 12 functional nodes.
